articles.title: Ethereum developers propose first step to protect ETH staking from quantum attacks
articles.snippet: A draft proposal would allow validators to deposit with quantum-resistant keys, then permanently stop accepting the format the network runs on today.

articles.title: Euro stablecoins get a mainstream push as Revolut begins rolling out EURR in Europe
articles.snippet: Revolut said the stablecoin’s rollout will start with a select group of customers within Denmark, Poland, and Portugal.

articles.title: Japan to start stocks and bonds tokenization development plans this year
articles.snippet: Japan's regulators are racing to modernize national settlement systems to prevent institutional investors and foreign capital from fleeing to overseas markets.

articles.title: A massive $6.4 billion bitcoin options expiry on Friday could amplify volatility
articles.snippet: Friday’s expiry follows bitcoin’s surge from $62,000 to $80,000, leaving market makers with increased exposure to manage around several key strike prices.

articles.title: Crypto custody firm Copper has potential buyers. But offers are way below its $500 million asking price
articles.snippet: Once valued at $2.5 billion, Copper was being marketed by investment bank Cantor Fitzgerald at around $500 million in May this year.
